stories.title: Welsh Government rejects Reform UK call for English takeover of Betsi Cadwaladr
stories.summary: Reform UK Wales have called for the drastic measure of appointing an English team to take over Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board as it continues to struggle in special measures.
